_comment: Known-good sidecar binaries for this project, pinned by SHA-256.
The binaries themselves are gitignored (247 MB) and have never been
committed, so losing src-tauri/bin/ made the project UNBUILDABLE with no
recorded way back: prebuild failed on a missing file, and nothing said
which version to go and get. This manifest is that record. It answers two
questions the repository previously could not: exactly which build is
known to work, and whether the file on disk is that build.
scripts/verify-external-bins.mjs checks disk against these hashes.
A MISMATCH IS NOT AUTOMATICALLY AN ERROR -- a newer FFmpeg is a legitimate
upgrade -- but it must be a deliberate one, so it warns rather than
passing in silence. Update the hash here when you intend the change.
Licensing matters because these are redistributed inside the installer:
both are FFmpeg-derived and GPL/LGPL. Ship the licence text with any

ffmpeg.note: ffmpeg and ffprobe come from the SAME archive; upgrade them together.

ffgac.note: ffgac and ffedit ship in the SAME FFglitch release; upgrade them together.
